summary: Clean simplification replacing temp .pgpass file + PGPASSFILE with PGPASSWORD env var and subprocess.run, matching the issue request. Correctly resolves the problem with no regression; this mirrors the actual upstream-accepted approach.

issues.description: subprocess.check_call -> subprocess.run drops check=True, so a non-zero psql exit no longer raises CalledProcessError. Acceptable for an interactive dbshell (exit codes are user-driven), but it is a silent behavioral change worth noting.

PGPASSWORD is slightly less secure than a 0600 .pgpass file (env visible via ps to same-user processes on some OSes) and drops the prior UnicodeEncodeError fallback to manual entry. Known, accepted tradeoff; not merge-blocking.
